units.source_text: 谁知，就连这麦比乌斯圈，对他的休假也明显表示出与其他同事相同的灰色的嫉妒。

en.t: Who would have thought, even this Mobius strip plainly showed the same gray jealousy toward his vacation as his other colleagues.
It was hardly like a Mobius strip at all.

units.source_text: 他觉得好没趣，同时又有一股痛快的感觉。

en.t: He found it terribly dull, yet at the same time felt a certain sense of satisfaction.

units.source_text: 相对于美德，往往谁都会做出捉弄人的事来。

en.t: When faced with virtue, almost anyone is apt to do something teasing or mischievous.

units.source_text: 结果，想要使人着急一下的期待心情，变得十分沉重了。

en.t: As a result, the expectant feeling of wanting to make someone a little anxious became very heavy.
